bookSourceComment: MangaDex（日漫为主，官方 API）：搜索/详情/目录/图片全走 api.mangadex.org，图片走 @Home 节点。中文翻译覆盖率低，没有中文时自动退到英文。
header: {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36", "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*", "Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,ja;q=0.8,en;q=0.7"}

ruleSearch.name: @js:(function(){var a=JSON.parse(result).attributes||{};var t=a.title||{};var alt=a.altTitles||[];var od=['zh','zh-hk','ja','ja-ro','en'];for(var i=0;i<od.length;i++){if(t[od[i]]){return t[od[i]];}}for(var j=0;j<alt.length;j++){for(var k=0;k<od.length;k++){if(alt[j][od[k]]){return alt[j][od[k]];}}}return '未命名';})()
ruleSearch.author: @js:(function(){var d=JSON.parse(result);var rel=d.relationships||[];for(var i=0;i<rel.length;i++){if(rel[i].type==='author'&&rel[i].attributes&&rel[i].attributes.name){return rel[i].attributes.name;}}return '';})()
ruleSearch.kind: @js:(function(){var a=JSON.parse(result).attributes||{};var tg=a.tags||[];var out=[];for(var i=0;i<tg.length;i++){var n=(tg[i].attributes&&tg[i].attributes.name)||{};if(n.zh){out.push(n.zh);}else if(n.en){out.push(n.en);}}return out.join(' ');})()

ruleBookInfo.name: @js:(function(){var a=JSON.parse(result).data.attributes||{};var t=a.title||{};var alt=a.altTitles||[];var od=['zh','zh-hk','ja','ja-ro','en'];for(var i=0;i<od.length;i++){if(t[od[i]]){return t[od[i]];}}for(var j=0;j<alt.length;j++){for(var k=0;k<od.length;k++){if(alt[j][od[k]]){return alt[j][od[k]];}}}return '未命名';})()
ruleBookInfo.author: @js:(function(){var d=JSON.parse(result).data;var rel=d.relationships||[];for(var i=0;i<rel.length;i++){if(rel[i].type==='author'&&rel[i].attributes&&rel[i].attributes.name){return rel[i].attributes.name;}}return '';})()

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){var j=JSON.parse(result);var data=(j.data||[]).slice();var total=j.total||data.length;var url=baseUrl;var off=500;while(data.length=0?'&':'?';var more=java.ajax(url+sep+'offset='+off);var arr=[];try{arr=(JSON.parse(more).data)||[];}catch(e){arr=[];}if(!arr.length){break;}for(var i=0;i0)){continue;}var num=a.chapter||'';var ti=a.title||'';var label=(num?('第'+num+'话'):'番外')+(ti?(' '+ti):'');out.push(''+label.replace(/[<>]/g,'')+'');}return out;})()

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var id=String(baseUrl).split('/chapter/')[1]||'';id=id.split(/[\/?#]/)[0];if(!id){return '';}var raw=java.ajax('https://api.mangadex.org/at-home/server/'+id);var o=JSON.parse(raw);var ch=o.chapter||{};var files=ch.dataSaver||ch.data||[];var out=[];for(var i=0;i');}return out.join('');})()
